create_eval_callback: create an evaluation callback that computes loss and accuracy on a DataLoader for a named split
create_timekeeper_callback: create a timekeeper callback that prints elapsed time between training iterations on the primary process
standard_callbacks: build a list of training callbacks for checkpointing, model saving, and evaluation at start, end, and every epoch
run_every_epoch: wrap a callback so it runs only once per epoch when the iteration counter is zero
run_at_step: wrap a callback so it runs only at a specific Step during training
